title: UW Markdown Gaps Section
description: Content payload for the `gaps` standard section (UW_FORMAT_SPEC.md §4.22). Enumerates open data gaps blocking stage advancement or carrying provisional defaults.

items.description: Open gap inventory. Each entry names a missing or low-quality field, optionally with the stage it blocks and an owner.

section.description: Section ID where the gap lives.

field_path.description: Optional dot-notated path within the section's content. When omitted, the gap applies to the whole section.

reason.description: Why this gap exists. `missing` and `illegible` typically come from L0 ingestion; `awaiting_external` is used for third-party reports.

blocks_stage.description: Lowest stage that cannot advance until this gap closes.

first_seen.description: When this gap was first recorded.

last_checked.description: RFC 0122: DQ-05 reads a calendar-valid YYYY-MM-DD at UTC midnight or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm[:ss[.1-3 digits]] with uppercase Z or signed HH:mm offset. Years 0001-9999, hours/offset hours 00-23, minutes/seconds 00-59. Invalid strings do not establish staleness; no host-local parsing.

owner.description: Actor or agent responsible for resolving the gap.

summary.description: Aggregate counts for fast pipeline routing. Recomputed on every gap maintenance write.

items.note: Awaiting unit-level rent roll from broker.
Using asset-class default until T-12 arrives.
